model_output.verdict: A construction project manager with project values, trade counts, and delivery results a recruiter can follow.
write_up: This is a strong construction project manager resume! Your Capitol Builders work shows the projects you run, their values, and results on schedule and change orders. A recruiter can quickly see your commercial construction work and how much you handle.

The line about running 4 to 6 concurrent tenant-improvement projects is a good model: it names the work and the value of each project. Experience leads Education, and your move from assistant project manager to project manager is easy to follow.

Let's add what you did to get the grocery build ahead of schedule and keep change orders under 3%. Your resume gives a recruiter plenty to work with already; how competitive a particular opening is will matter too.

cards.line: - Run 4 to 6 concurrent tenant-improvement projects worth $1M to $8M each
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It puts the number of concurrent projects and their individual values right next to the work you run.

cards.line: - Delivered a $14M grocery store build 3 weeks ahead of schedule in 2024
cards.cannot_tell: The early delivery is a strong result. A recruiter can't yet see what you did to get the build there.
cards.example: Delivered a $14M grocery store build 3 weeks ahead of schedule in 2024 by [what you did to keep the build ahead of schedule]
cards.question: What did you do to bring the grocery store build in ahead of schedule?

cards.line: - Kept change orders under 3% of contract value across 2024 and 2025 projects
cards.cannot_tell: This gives a recruiter a useful figure across multiple projects. It doesn't say how you managed changes to keep them there.
cards.example: Kept change orders under 3% of contract value across 2024 and 2025 projects by [what you did to manage changes]
cards.question: What did you do to manage changes across those projects?

cards.line: - Manage subcontractor bids and buyout for 20 to 30 trades per project
cards.cannot_tell: For a role above project manager, a decision you made across projects could show responsibility beyond individual trade buyouts.
cards.example: Manage subcontractor bids and buyout for 20 to 30 trades per project and [a decision you made across projects]
cards.question: What decisions, if any, have you made across projects beyond individual trade buyouts?
